en-US.description:
ClockIn Admin Plus helps managers run daily operations for workforce time tracking. Review punches, monitor schedules, manage teams by location, and keep staff records organized from one admin workspace.

Features
- Admin and manager access with tenant-based login
- View and manage employee punch activity
- Team and location workflow support
- Operational tools for schedules and reporting
- Built for organizations using the ClockIn platform

Requires an active ClockIn organization account.
en-US.title: ClockIn Admin Plus
en-US.subtitle: Admin time operations
